    📖 How to use

    1. Type a password in the field.
    2. Watch entropy, crack time, and the strength bar update live.
    3. Follow the concrete feedback to improve it.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How is entropy calculated?

    Entropy = length × log2(character set size). A 16-char password from 94 symbols has ~105 bits.

    How is crack time estimated?

    Assuming 10 billion guesses/second: 2^(bits-1) seconds, shown in human units from seconds to billions of years.

    Is a high score a guarantee?

    Estimates assume offline attacks. Use a password manager and unique passwords per site regardless of score.

    Is my password sent anywhere?

    Yes — everything is computed locally; the password never leaves your browser.
